title: Original pinned enumeration bootstrap and iterable consumers
oracle: Literal ordered entries/keys/values, ECMAScript Object.keys ordering and native String iterator code-point facts, strict primitive sequence metamorphisms, identity-fastpath and explicit remaining-stream state tables. Generic fallback over actual arrays characterizes captured Object.keys with lazy indexed value reads using native push/shift on the retained array. No expected value comes from executing the vendor to create a golden; no callback or custom iterator/wrapper implementation replaces the producer or consumer. Original source-exact 2,930-byte FB_enumerate producer is separately admitted at a registered raw-parent origin and never enters Metro module groups.

trials.sourceScope: Eight original Metro modules plus one distinct bootstrap asset at each revision; analyzer4 includes both root kinds
trials.plainObjectIdentity: Fresh entry tuples compare unequal under default strict comparator; identical object reference takes the source fastpath
trials.stringLengthScope: UTF16 length prechecks can reject equivalent code-point streams, an emoji string versus one-element array
trials.bootstrapAdmission: Configured private root only; missing root removes this capability and invalid selected bytes fail explicitly
trials.inputDomains: Unbounded numeric/string/object/sequence domains are characterized by bounded synthetic cases only

exclusions: Full selected graphs include eight Metro modules plus the exact original FB_enumerate asset. Analyzer 4 default two-million work budget completes with zero gate descriptors and no unresolved diagnostics. One empty finite gate context is executed within this selected source scope, not every possible JavaScript behavior or gated caller.

Only one primary verified raw parent per revision is declared for the common 2,930-byte producer. Raw bytes stay private and are read only through the configured revision/hash cache path with registered origin/hash/span validation. Alternate raw parents and full bundle/prelude bootstrap are not executed.
Original Babel helpers remain separate from source-exact FB_enumerate. This suite does not select Babel asset execution or relabel compatibility fixtures as canonical helpers.

Direct arrays/strings and byte views use their actual source-selected native/fallback iteration behavior. generic explicitly exercises the object fallback on arrays to observe snapshot keys and lazy indexed values; it does not establish arbitrary plain-object property addition/deletion or accessor behavior.
Retained actual iterators are advanced through fresh original WAIterableOperators.iteratorFromArray consumers. This is a chosen diagnostic bridge, not a production consumer or custom wrapper.

equalsIterable default strict comparator and falsy fallback are covered; custom callback comparators, map/filter callbacks, symbols, Maps/Sets, proxies, getters and arbitrary user code are not injected or covered.

Object entry tuples, UTF16 length versus code-point iteration, non-callable comparator errors and early mismatch leaving iterators open are source characterizations, not corrected generalized equality semantics.

Case inputs and iterator histories remain unbounded. Generated lengths through65 and finite literal sequences do not prove all iterable implementations, reentrancy, concurrent mutation or hostile callbacks.

No network, provider, storage, timers, browser/native account, entropy, cryptographic operation or named-library adapter is exercised. Diagnostic process execution reports isolated:false; containers and production TS-suite scheduling remain unexercised.
